baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative قوا expands in sequence from أنفسكم to أهليكم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Trusted belief becomes an enacted barrier: care begins with the self as a whole locus of agency and widens to the nearest community of belonging. The sequence makes self-formation the first ring of household protection rather than allowing concern for kin to bypass the condition of the protector.

activation_trace.role: The security-and-trust branch makes the address an entrusted condition that is to become protective practice.
The barrier against harm supplies the governing action and the outer shape of the mechanism.
The self as the thing in its entirety makes the first protected unit a whole agent, not one detachable faculty.
The branch of proximity and affiliation widens the second ring beyond a bare list of biological dependents.

changed_reading.before: Avoid the punishment individually and warn one's family about it.
changed_reading.after: Build a concentric practice of protection whose first ring is one's whole self and whose next ring is the network of nearest belonging.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fire is specified by its fuel, الناس والحجارة, rather than only by its heat or location.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus depicts an operating combustion system: an ignited fire persists by converting human and stone material into fuel. Naming the feedstock changes the threat from a static destination into a process with inputs, persistence, and custodians.

activation_trace.role: The kindled-fire branch supplies the active consuming medium rather than a merely symbolic place-name.
The fuel-material branch makes people and stones inputs that keep the fire operating.
The manifest human collective identifies one class of combustible input as persons, not anonymous matter.
The hard-stone branch supplies the resistant material paired with human fuel.

changed_reading.before: The verse names a terrible fire containing people and stones.
changed_reading.after: The verse exposes a maintained combustion economy whose human and mineral inputs make the danger continue.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening human imperative is followed by agents over the fire who neither disobey what they are commanded nor leave it undone.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two linked regimes frame the danger. Believers receive an upstream preventive commission; the angels form a downstream execution layer in which command passes into action without slippage. Their hardness and strength function as procedural invariance, while the active and passive forms of أمر close the relay around فعل.

activation_trace.role: The protective imperative locates the addressees upstream of the enforcement scene.
The angel branch identifies the appointed agents stationed over the process.
Harsh, rough treatment contributes unyielding enforcement rather than discretionary softness.
Strength and solidity keep the execution layer from yielding under pressure.
The negated departure from obedience removes a possible break in the relay.
The demand-and-obligation branch spans both commanding and being commanded, enclosing the resulting act.
The production of an act is the terminal output of the command relay.

changed_reading.before: The verse first commands believers, then separately describes severe guards.
changed_reading.after: The verse contrasts preventive human agency with an angelic execution system in which obligation becomes action without a gap.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the protective imperative, domestic pressure produces a prohibition of what was made lawful, and the next ayah supplies release from binding oaths while naming God as the one who undertakes care. This revises protection from maximal restriction into calibrated boundary work that can include undoing a self-imposed bond.

activation_trace.role: The genuine barrier against harm is the focus action whose calibration is at issue.
The near-affiliation branch anchors the revision in the focus ayah's household sphere.
Prohibition supplies a boundary that looks protective but is challenged as misapplied.
The lifting of prohibition marks the lawful thing that the improvised boundary wrongly enclosed.
Seeking another's satisfaction supplies the domestic pressure that can distort risk and rule.
The marital branch locates that distortion inside the relational field later addressed as family.
Release from an oath gives protection an authorized unbinding operation, not only a tightening operation.
The binding oath supplies the knot whose persistence is not itself equated with faithfulness.
Undertaking and care relocate final guardianship beyond anxious self-binding.

structural_cues: 66:1-2 place domestic prohibition and its lawful dissolution directly before the family-protection imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies misapplied prohibition, spouse-directed appeasement, oath release, and divine guardianship; I infer that قوا requires calibrated rather than maximal restriction. A live alternative is that 66:1-2 correct only one vow and do not specify a general method for 66:6.

changed_reading.before: Protecting a household means adding prohibitions wherever danger is feared.
changed_reading.after: Protecting a household means discerning real boundaries from appeasing or self-invented ones, and sometimes lawfully loosening the latter.

context_deltas.mechanism: A concealed communication becomes a renewed report, crosses the marital boundary, and is made manifest; the response then recognizes only part and turns aside from part. This activates the household as an information membrane whose protection depends on trust, controlled circulation, and proportionate exposure rather than either total secrecy or total disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The barrier against harm provides the focus mechanism now applied to information flow.
The household-affiliation branch anchors the membrane in the exact social unit named by the focus.
Concealment places a communication on the inside of the domestic boundary.
A report renewed as speech supplies the transmissible item that can cross the boundary.
Emergence into visibility is the endpoint of the secret's failed containment.
Discriminating by marks supports a measured response to only the portion selected for acknowledgment.
Turning one's side away supplies deliberate non-exposure of the remaining portion.

structural_cues: 66:3 moves from a private dyad through transmission and disclosure to a deliberately partial response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, report, disclosure, recognition, and selective turning away; I infer that hazardous information flow is one possible domain of family protection. A live alternative is that the sequence concerns accountability for one disclosure without yielding a broader household protocol.

changed_reading.before: The protective barrier in 66:6 is mainly against an external moral or physical threat.
changed_reading.after: One household danger is uncontrolled information flow, so protection can require trustworthy containment and proportionate rather than total exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense is tied to enacted work, and the later counterexample places two wives in intimate proximity to righteous servants yet denies that proximity any power to suffice for them. Their own breach of trust terminates in entry into the same fire named by the focus. Family protection is therefore a real duty without becoming transferable agency or guaranteed control of another's outcome.

activation_trace.role: The whole self remains the irreducible first unit of responsibility.
Near affiliation creates a field of care but does not by itself specify transfer of outcome.
The matching of act to recompense makes consequence answer to agency rather than kinship.
Purposive action supplies the individually attributable input to that matching.
The obedient-service branch establishes the genuine righteousness of the intimate counterparts.
Soundness opposed to corruption intensifies the failed expectation that a righteous spouse can secure another.
A deficit of fidelity supplies the wives' own agency within the relation.
Negated sufficiency explicitly blocks the transfer of salvific capacity through the spouses.
Entry into an interior supplies the realized endpoint that relational proximity did not avert.
The repeated kindled fire closes the counterexample back onto the focus threat.

structural_cues: 66:6 orders self before family; 66:7 ties recompense to one's work; 66:10 tests the limit through spouses of righteous servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies act-matched recompense, intimate righteous proximity, betrayal, lack of sufficiency, and entry into fire; I infer that protective duty does not confer control over another self. A live alternative is that 66:10 concerns only unbelief despite prophetic proximity, while ordinary family responsibility can still be described more strongly.

changed_reading.before: A faithful guardian can secure the family's final outcome by sufficient proximity, authority, or merit.
changed_reading.after: The guardian must protect and teach without imagining that kinship transfers agency or guarantees another person's outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that supplies the focus fire later supplies light moving purposefully before and beside the believers. Sincere repentance is activated by the branch image of sewing a tear, and the moving light remains something to be completed. The protective task can therefore be read dynamically as repair that redirects a consuming luminous process into guidance rather than merely as distance from flame.

activation_trace.role: The fire branch supplies consuming luminosity at the threatened endpoint.
Fuel material explains how the destructive luminous state is sustained.
Sewing and closing a tear gives sincere return a concrete repair operation.
Illumination supplies the non-consuming counterpart that belongs to the believers and guides them.
Purposeful movement turns light into an advancing guide rather than passive brightness.
Completion makes the beneficial luminous state developmental and still open to increase.

structural_cues: 66:8 repeats the address to believers and repeats ن و ر twice after its fire use in 66:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire, fuel, mending, mobile light, and requested completion; I supply the directional arrow from repair toward a changed luminous state. A live alternative is that fire and light are simply opposed outcomes, with no conversion relation between them.

changed_reading.before: Protection means keeping people at a distance from a fixed fire.
changed_reading.after: Protection can include mending ruptures so that luminosity no longer consumes people as fuel but moves ahead of them as still-completable guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus assigns harshness to angels stationed over the fire, while 66:9 repeats the same quality as an explicit command toward named adversarial groups. The family imperative itself uses protection, not harshness. This distribution separates caring prevention from hard enforcement instead of treating angelic severity as the household method.

activation_trace.role: The barrier against harm names the human family's positive commission.
Rough severity is attached to the angelic enforcement agents rather than to the family imperative.
Exertion under hardship supplies the active struggle within which the later harshness is commanded.
The displayed entrance with a hidden exit images the covert adversarial category explicitly targeted.
The repeated roughness is now a directed command with stated objects, sharpening its role boundary.

structural_cues: Harshness is adjectival for the angels in 66:6, absent from قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم, and transitive toward named opponents in 66:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three distinct grammatical assignments; I infer that the distribution limits imitation of angelic harshness inside the household. A live alternative is that 66:9 intensifies a general ethic of severity rather than containing it by role and object.

changed_reading.before: Believers should protect their families by reproducing the harshness of the angels described next.
changed_reading.after: Family protection is preventive care; harshness belongs to specifically assigned enforcement roles and explicitly named objects.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believing wife located inside Pharaoh's household asks for a house to be built in another proximity and twice asks for rescue by separation: from the spouse and his work, then from the unjust collective. The focus household is thus not every inherited or current domestic enclosure at any cost; protection can require exiting a corrupt affiliation and assembling a truer home.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch of nearness and affiliation is the household category that the counter-house reconfigures.
Building by joining parts supplies the constructive operation for an alternative belonging.
Nearness and presence redefine the desired home's governing proximity.
Shelter and dwelling give the requested alternative an architectural form.
The household branch lets the new dwelling also reactivate who counts as one's people.
Rescue through separation supplies the necessary break from the existing domestic and social systems.
Purposive work shows that rescue is sought not only from a person but from the operative pattern he produces.
The collective branch widens the harmful household into a surrounding social affiliation.
Withholding and confinement from right explain why separation, rather than preservation of the unit, becomes protective.

structural_cues: 66:11 counterposes a present marriage and polity with a requested house in a different nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a wife, a requested new house, changed proximity, and rescue by separation from spouse, work, and unjust group; I infer that family protection may require reconstructing affiliation. A live alternative confines the requested house and rescue to the afterlife without a general critique of preserving harmful households.

changed_reading.before: Protecting family means preserving the current household enclosure and its existing bonds.
changed_reading.after: Protection can mean leaving an unjust domestic-social system and constructing a household ordered by a different proximity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary's guarded opening is not rendered as a permanently sealed wall: wind or breath crosses it bearing life, after which words are actively confirmed. Put beside the focus barrier, this activates protection as selective permeability, preserving an opening from violation while allowing life-giving ingress and truthful reception.

activation_trace.role: The protective barrier is the focus structure revised from a sealed wall into a discerning boundary.
Breath emerging from an interior gives the protected self a respiratory, boundary-crossing dimension.
Preservation within a surrounding fortress supplies the strong enclosure.
An exposed opening at a point of danger ensures that the enclosure still has a vulnerable aperture.
Sending air into something supplies the permitted crossing of that aperture.
Life-bearing spirit makes the crossing generative rather than invasive.
Making word and act true supplies an active test and reception after the opening.
Intelligible speech connecting parties gives the boundary a communicative channel as well as a bodily one.

structural_cues: 66:12 sequences enclosure, aperture, incoming breath, life, and confirmation rather than enclosure alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fortress, dangerous opening, entering air, life, and verified communication; I infer a selectively permeable model of قوا. A live alternative is that Mary's singular sign cannot be generalized into a household boundary mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Protection is an impermeable enclosure that succeeds by sealing every opening.
changed_reading.after: Protection is a discerning membrane: it guards vulnerable openings while remaining capable of admitting life and truthful communication.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates enclosure and encircling branches of حجر beside the actual hard stone, then reverses them when the stone is named as fuel. It remains anchored in the focus's direct juxtaposition of الوقاية and الحجارة as combustible material. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy about rigid defenses, not claim that الحجارة lexically means a failed wall here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ayah commands a protective barrier and then places stone, a paradigmatic hard barrier-material, inside the fuel supply.

activation_trace.role: A barrier against harm establishes the defensive function that stone might ordinarily serve.
Prevention and enclosure activate the stone material's latent defensive affordance.
Hard stone keeps the analogy materially anchored in the surface referent.
The circle around a thing sharpens the image of an enclosing defensive perimeter.
Fuel status reverses the expected defense by making the hard enclosing material sustain the threat.

changed_reading.before: Stone is simply the second kind of fuel listed after people.
changed_reading.after: Even hard material associated with barriers can be captured by the furnace and made to feed it; rigid defense is not identical with true protection.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it redescribes moral care as interference with a fuel supply chain. It remains visibly anchored because the exact people to be protected belong to the same human class expressly named as fuel. Downstream prose should mark counter-logistics as a causal material metaphor, not as an assertion that the verse describes a literal procurement system.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The addressees must protect selves and family immediately before humans are identified as the fire's fuel.

activation_trace.role: Protection removes exposed persons from the harm-producing relation.
The living person identifies the first potential human input that the command seeks to preserve.
The affiliated group widens preservation to a network of potential human inputs.
The fuel-material branch turns exposure into participation in the fire's continued operation.
The human collective closes the identity between those protected and the class consumed as fuel.

changed_reading.before: Protection shelters people from an independently existing fire.
changed_reading.after: Every protected person also interrupts the fire's human feedstock, so household care acts as counter-logistics against the combustion system.

strongest_changes: The preceding domestic correction makes protection calibrated boundary work rather than maximal or appeasing prohibition.
The spouse counterexample preserves intense family duty while denying that kinship, authority, or righteousness can transfer agency and guarantee outcomes.
The repeated ن و ر root lets sincere mending activate a live movement from consuming fire toward forward-moving, still-completable light.
The Pharaoh-wife example allows protection to include rescue from a household and construction of a different belonging.
The final guarded-opening sequence keeps a strange but coherent selectively permeable model alive alongside the stronger barrier model.
summary.what_was_special: The focus first generated a combustion system and a command relay, but context changed both: domestic knots may need lawful loosening, secrets reveal household permeability, proximity cannot substitute for action, harshness is distributed by role, fire is answered by mobile light, and a guarded opening can admit life. The hardest surprise was internal to the focus itself: stone can evoke the wall one would build for protection and then appear as fuel, so rigidity can be captured by the danger it meant to stop.
remaining_uncertainties: The fire-to-light trajectory is an abductive relation activated by a shared root and sequence, not an explicit claim that one substance converts into the other.
The selective-permeability model generalizes from Mary's singular sign and should remain exploratory.
Role-bounded harshness depends on syntactic distribution; the live rival reading treats 66:9 as widening rather than limiting severity.
Calibrated boundaries do not determine which concrete household limits are required; they only block equating protection with restriction as such.
